text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English,

text: the podcast where we have real conversations.

zh_hant: 這是一個我們進行真實對話的播客

text: in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 用简单的英语帮你学习
zh_hant: 用簡單的英語幫你學習

text: I'm Beth.
zh: 我是贝丝
zh_hant: 我是貝絲

text: And I'm Neil.
zh: 我是尼尔

text: You can watch this podcast and test yourself with a worksheet,

text: which you can get free on our website at bbclearningenglish.com.

text: So, Neil, how are you today?

text: I'm very well, actually.

text: Feeling confident?

text: I'm feeling confident.

zh_hant: 我有信心

text: Are you feeling nervous?

text: Not at all.

text: No, I'm feeling confident.
zh: 不，我很有信心

text: Well, today we're talking all about confidence.
zh: 那今天我们要聊的全是关于信心
zh_hant: 那今天我們要聊的全是關於信心

text: So, listeners might be familiar with the adjective confident,
zh: 那么，听众们可能熟悉形容词confident

text: which means being certain about something, feeling good about yourself.
zh: 意思是确定某事，对自己感觉良好
zh_hant: 意思是確定某事，對自己感覺良好

text: But confidence is the noun,
zh: 但confidence是名词

text: and it's that feeling of being certain,
zh: 它是一种确信的感觉
zh_hant: 它是一種確信的感覺

text: maybe about your own abilities or about a situation.
zh: 可能是对自己能力或某种情境的确定
zh_hant: 可能是對自己能力或某種情境的確定

text: OK, that's a good description, Beth.
zh: 好的，这个描述很好，贝丝
zh_hant: 好的，這個描述很好，貝絲

text: Would you say you are a confident person?
zh: 你觉得你是一个自信的人吗？
zh_hant: 你覺得你是一個自信的人嗎？

text: I think it really depends on the situation.
zh: 我觉得这真的要看情况

text: So if I am speaking with you like this,

zh_hant: 所以，如果我像這樣和你說話，

text: I'm very confident, I know you.
zh: 我很有信心，因为我认识你
zh_hant: 我很有信心，因為我認識你

text: But if I'm around people that I don't know as much,

text: then I usually feel a bit more shy.

zh_hant: 那我通常會感覺更害羞一些

text: Yeah.
zh: 嗯
zh_hant: 嗯

text: What about you?
zh: 你呢？
zh_hant: 你呢？

text: Are you generally confident?

zh_hant: 你一般來說自信嗎？

text: I think, like you, if I think I know what I'm doing,

zh_hant: 我覺得和你一樣，如果我覺得自己知道在做什麼

text: then I'm confident.

zh_hant: 那我就會有信心

text: But if I'm doing something, especially with people

zh_hant: 但如果我在做某件事，尤其是和人在一起

text: who maybe know more about that thing than I do,
zh: 那些人可能比我更懂那件事
zh_hant: 那些人可能比我更懂那件事

text: then that can be nerve-wracking,

zh_hant: 那就會讓人緊張

text: make you feel nervous and then not be confident.

text: Yeah, definitely.
zh: 对，绝对的
zh_hant: 對，絕對的

text: I remember being in a classroom,
zh: 我记得在教室里
zh_hant: 我記得在教室裡

text: and if I feel like this topic is just,
zh: 如果我觉得这个主题就是
zh_hant: 如果我覺得這個主題就是

text: I don't know, then I would not feel confident at all,
zh: 不知道，那我就会完全没有信心
zh_hant: 不知道，那我就會完全沒有信心

text: definitely feel nervous.
zh: 肯定会紧张
zh_hant: 肯定會緊張

zh: 还有什么样的情境会让你感到害羞或紧张？
zh_hant: 還有什麼樣的情境會讓你感到害羞或緊張？

text: I think apart from meeting new people,

zh_hant: 我覺得除了認識新朋友

text: I always feel a bit nervous with that.
zh: 那总是让我有点紧张
zh_hant: 那總是讓我有點緊張

text: I'm generally quite confident.

zh_hant: 我一般還是挺自信的

zh_hant: 所以如果涉及到像公開演講這種事

text: where I have to talk in front of a lot of people,

zh_hant: 我得在很多人面前講話

text: if they're people I don't know,

zh_hant: 如果是不認識的人

text: I don't really have a problem.
zh: 我其实没什么问题
zh_hant: 我其實沒什麼問題

text: I'm quite confident.
zh: 我挺自信的
zh_hant: 我挺自信的

zh_hant: 但如果我得對一屋子人說話，而我又認識這些人

text: that would make me more nervous.
zh: 那会让我更紧张
zh_hant: 那會讓我更緊張

text: I don't know if that's weird.
zh: 我不知道这是不是有点怪

text: Maybe.

zh_hant: 也許吧

text: I think I'm probably the opposite.
zh: 我觉得我可能正好相反
zh_hant: 我覺得我可能正好相反

text: Really?
zh: 真的吗？
zh_hant: 真的嗎？

zh_hant: 如果我和不認識的人說話

zh_hant: 我沒太多信心，除非我準備得非常充分

text: I think being prepared is a good way to boost your confidence.
zh: 我认为做好准备工作是增强自信的好方法。
zh_hant: 我認為做好準備工作是增強自信的好方法。

text: Yeah, I remember watching a video about a lady saying,

text: if you want to improve your confidence,

text: and think about all the good things that you're going to do,

text: that's really can be quite scary.

zh_hant: 尤其是在外國城市，會讓人緊張

zh_hant: 讓人緊張
